args.summary: Deploy of v2.3.1 caused health check failures and 18% error rate across us-east, us-west, and eu-west in production. Rolled back all regions to the most recent healthy release, v2.3.0. Rollback completed and service is healthy again: error rate down to 0.2%, health checks passing in all regions. Follow-up: investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression before redeploying.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Diagnosis**: `checkout-api` v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was failing health checks in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
- **Rollback**: Rolled all production regions back to **v2.3.0**. Verified recovery — service is now healthy in all regions with error rate down to ~0.2%.
- **Incident**: Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0"); the on-call engineer has been paged. The incident notes the v2.3.1 regression as a follow-up investigation item before any redeploy.
